system_configurations.name: RCCL-AINIC-ABC
system_configurations.description: AINIC A/B/C test plan. Group A: NetIbMPI + GIN component/unit tests (2 nodes x 1 GPU = 2 ranks). Group B: NCCL_NET plugin x knobs sweep on rccl-tests perf (2 nodes x 8 GPU = 16 ranks), including out-of-the-box autodetect. Group C: IONIC hardware counter validation. Run on the AINIC cluster with --system ainic. TEMPORARY: RCCL_MODEL_MATCHING_DISABLE=1 in the global env_variables is a temporary workaround for spurious Rome-preset topology-consensus aborts and MUST be removed once that root cause is fixed.

mpi_args.ainic: --bind-to numa --mca pml ob1 --mca osc ^ucx --mca btl tcp,self --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno0

a_netib_component.description: A1-A3: NetIb plugin init, properties, data path.

tests.name: A1_NetIB_InitializePlugin
tests.description: Verifies IB-CAST plugin init and libionic.so load on AINIC.

tests.name: A2_NetIB_GetDeviceProperties
tests.description: Verifies IONIC devices (rdma0+) are visible and properties valid.

tests.name: A3_NetIB_SimpleSendRecv
tests.description: Verifies basic send/recv over AINIC data path (no collectives).

a_cts_workaround.description: A4: CTS-off P2P stress (16x64=1024 outstanding). Do NOT bump CTS_QP_DEPTH to 256 or it will time out.

tests.name: A4_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOff
tests.description: CTS-off P2P stress path passes cleanly (1024 outstanding recvs drain fully).

tests.name: A5_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOn
tests.description: Reproduces AINIC CTS match-table overflow (~256 entries); expected to time out.

a_cast_base.description: CAST base: full WRR env required or tests GTEST_SKIP. No tests here; children extend.

tests.name: A7_Cast_EqualWeightsTwoQPsTokenCounts
tests.description: WRR scheduler balances 2 QPs without corruption (token table sane).

tests.name: A8_Cast_SingleQPBypassesWrr

a_fault_inject.description: A9: per-QP fault injection on CAST path.

tests.name: A9_Cast_FaultInjQpErrorIsFatal
tests.description: QP fault is detected (fatal) and does not corrupt other QPs on CAST path.

a_gin.description: A10-A15: GIN one-sided proxy tests. Require NCCL_NET=ib-cast.

tests.name: A10_Gin_IPutBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iput RDMA write over AINIC.

tests.name: A11_Gin_IGetBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iget RDMA read over AINIC.

tests.name: A12_Gin_IPutSignal
tests.description: GIN put-with-signal (atomic inc/add) completion semantics.

tests.name: A13_Gin_IFlushAfterIGet
tests.description: GIN GPU flush ordering after iget.

tests.name: A14_Gin_MultipleInflight
tests.description: Multiple outstanding GIN iput/iget complete without corruption.

tests.name: A15_Gin_IPutSignalStress10k
tests.description: Stress: 10k put-with-signal ops, signal counter must equal 10000 (no drops).

b_base.description: Sweep base: derived suites run the full 1024-16G range for both allreduce and alltoall (widened from earlier 128M/8G caps), including b_large_alltoall_repro. Group B intentionally sets NO shared env_variables here (NCCL_LAUNCH_MODE, NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX, NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS were removed per spec so each sweep runs against stock defaults plus its own per-suite knobs). NOTE: no group-level command_args here by design - every test in every group extending b_base sets its own explicit, complete command_args (see test_executor.py's suite+test command_args concatenation) so no flags get silently duplicated.
